summary: A note can be marked done: PATCH /api/notes/{note_id} with {"done": bool} returns the updated note (404 for an unknown id, 422 for a non-boolean or extra field); every note has a boolean done that starts false; DELETE /api/notes still empties the store. The page shows a Done/Undo span (not a button) per note and a done note is struck through.
